results.method: lineage share of the within-stratum mid-distribution score

results.reason: The largest share attained by an arrangement of the lineages inside the readings is 0.627
results.assumptions: Every reading holds the latent MIC it stands for (a call: the side of its cut-off); the latent MIC is continuous within a stratum; lineages of one isolate set aside.
